title: Christmas Nights into Dreams...
overview:
'Twas the NiGHTS before Christmas and all through the house not a creature was stirring not even a mouse... Well, maybe a virtual winter world filled with unbelievable real-time effects, fantastic creatures and beautiful Christmas themes. Seasons greetings from Sega.

Prepare to Fly!

The Christmas Star has vanished from the town tree, so Claris and Elliot return to the dream world of Nightopia to find NiGHTS and win it back. Fly NiGHTS through the Spring Valley dream as either child, collecting orbs and soaring through rings to score points before time runs out, then face the boss.

The Saturn's clock changes the game with the calendar. In December, item boxes become presents, rings become wreaths and the Nightopians dress as elves, while other dates through the year bring their own surprises. Play well to unlock extras such as a music mixer, a time attack and a special stage starring Sonic the Hedgehog.

- Sampler disc, not for resale
- For 1 player
